blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them. Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension.
We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.
blocks.zh:
概念通常被定义为抽象的,紧凑的知识表现,并被作为智能行为的基本单位对待. 然而,认知、心理学和AI缺乏一种共同的数学语言。 现代系统代表着作为矢量,分布,符号,图表等结构的概念,但这些形式主义一般被视作是相互竞争的,而不是共同问题的解决方案. 我们提出一种基于操作的观点,通过它们支持的概念操作来评价数学框架,确定13个在认知、心理学和AI之间反复出现的操作(包括相似性、组成、概括性和地基). 我们显示,10个框架体现了对概念的不同承诺,即自足内容、关系结构或不断发展的进程,这些承诺决定了每个行动自然支持哪些行动。 例如,基于矢量的模型可以促进分级的相似性和通用性,但与明确的构成有矛盾,而象征性的模型则支持组成,但提供但通用性差。 我们所审查的任何单一框架都自然支持所有没有延期的行动。
我们实证地用分类作为案例研究来检验这一账户,根据人类的判断,将关于同一项目的9个理论付诸实施。 尽管解决了同样的概念问题,理论产生不同的程序和结果,表明数学承诺决定了理论能够解释什么. 我们呼吁将内容、关系和进程视为共同首要的混合形式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “One of the pleasures of looking at the world through mathematical eyes is that you can see certain patterns that would otherwise be hidden.” – Steven Strogatz
blocks.zh: “通过数学眼睛观察世界的乐趣之一是,你可以看到某些本来会隐藏的图案。” - 史蒂芬・史塔格兹

blocks.en: Concepts are how intelligence compresses the world . A single concept like zebra lets us recognize a novel instance despite changes in pose or lighting, generalize to related categories like horse , understand that horse + stripes = zebra , and combine it with others into new thoughts like a zebra tea party . Modern LLMs, too, appear to form internal representations that support analogy, generalization, and other documented concept operations. This hints that concepts are as fundamental to artificial systems as to biological ones.
blocks.zh: 概念是智能如何压缩世界。 一个像斑马这样的单一概念让我们能够识别一个新颖的例子,尽管姿势或照明的变化, 概括到马等相关类别, 了解马+条纹=斑马, 现代有限责任公司似乎也形成了支持类比、概括和其他有文件记载的概念业务的内部表述。 这暗示概念对人工系统与生物系统一样具有根本意义.

blocks.en: While researchers agree that many cognitive systems converge to similar abstractions (concepts), there is no agreed mathematics of concepts ( LawrenceC and Jenner, 2023 ) . Modern AI represents concepts as vectors, graphs, symbolic predicates, probabilistic variables, sparse features, and many other forms ( Johnston and Fusi, 2023 ) . These are often viewed as competing representations, each with their own strengths and limitations. We argue that this framing is premature. Before asking which mathematics best represents concepts, we must first ask what it is we wish to represent .
blocks.zh: 虽然研究者同意许多认知系统与类似的抽象(概念)汇合,但概念的数学并没有达成一致(LawrenceC and Jenner, 2023). 现代AI代表着作为矢量,图,符号的上游,概率变量,稀有特征,以及许多其他形式的概念(Johnston and Fusi, 2023). 这些往往被视为相互竞争的表述,各有其优点和局限性。 我们认为,这种框架还为时过早。 在问哪个数学最能代表概念之前,我们必须首先问我们希望代表什么。

blocks.en: Scientific progress has often been driven by finding the right mathematical language. Differential equations transformed mechanics, probability formalized uncertainty, and graph theory reshaped the study of networks. Mathematics does not merely describe phenomena, but rather determines which structures become natural to represent and which questions become possible to ask. If concepts are the fundamental units of intelligence, then the mathematics used to represent them will shape the kinds of intelligent systems we can imagine and build.
blocks.zh: 科学进步的动力往往是找到正确的数学语言. 差异方程改变了力学,概率形式化的不确定性,以及图理理论重塑了网络的研究. 数学不仅描述了现象,而是决定了哪些结构成为自然代表,哪些问题成为可能. 如果概念是智力的基本单位,那么用来代表它们的数学将塑造我们能想象和构建的智能系统种类.

blocks.en: We propose that the fundamental object of study is not a particular representation of concepts, but the capabilities that concepts enable. Intelligence does not merely store concepts; concepts enable intelligent systems to compare and categorize, abstract and generalize, compose and reason, adapt meaning to context, connect knowledge to the world, and acquire and revise conceptual knowledge. At the same time, mathematical frameworks differ in whether they treat concepts as entities with intrinsic structure, as elements defined through their relations, or as processes that emerge and change over time. A mathematics of concepts must therefore support the operations concepts support .
blocks.zh: 我们提议,研究的根本目标不是概念的具体体现,而是概念所赋予的能力。 智能不只是存储概念;概念使智能系统能够比较和分类,抽象和概括,构思和理性,使意义适应上下文,将知识与世界联系起来,并获得和修订概念知识. 同时,数学框架在将概念视为具有内在结构的实体,作为通过其关系定义的要素,还是作为随时间推移而出现和变化的过程方面有所不同. 因此,概念数学必须支持操作概念。

blocks.en: We derive these operations by identifying capabilities that recur independently across comparative cognition, cognitive psychology, and AI, and use them to evaluate existing mathematical approaches. We argue that different mathematical languages capture complementary aspects of conceptual intelligence and together define a new research agenda: the mathematics of concepts.
blocks.zh: 我们通过识别在比较认知、认知心理学和人工智能中独立重复的能力来得出这些操作,并利用它们来评价现有的数学方法。 我们主张不同的数学语言捕捉概念智能的互补方面,共同定义一个新的研究议程:概念的数学.

blocks.en: This paper makes the following contributions: (i) an operation-based framework that defines a mathematics of concepts by the conceptual operations it supports rather than by a preferred representation, identifying thirteen operations that recur across comparative cognition, cognitive psychology, and AI (§ 2 ); (ii) a systematic comparison of ten mathematical frameworks against these operations, showing that each framework’s profile of strengths tracks a prior commitment to content, relation, or process (§ 4 , 5 , 6 , Table 2 ); (iii) an empirical categorization test-case operationalizing nine of these frameworks on the same dataset against human judgments, showing how mathematical commitment shapes both the procedure and the result for a single conceptual question (§ 7 , Table 5 ); and (iv) a diagnosis of why no existing framework spans content, relation, and process jointly, and a concrete agenda for hybrid formalisms that treat all three as jointly primary.
blocks.zh: 本文作出以下贡献:(一) 以操作为基础的框架,用它所支持的概念操作而不是偏爱的表示来定义概念的数学,确定跨越比较认知、认知心理学和AI(§2)反复出现的13项操作;(二) 系统比较10项数学框架与这些操作,显示每个框架的强项概况跟踪了对内容、关系或过程的事先承诺(§4、5、6,表2);(三) 将其中9项框架进行实证分类,对照人类判断,在同一个数据集上操作,表明数学承诺如何影响单一概念问题的程序和结果(§7,表5);(四) 分析为什么没有现有框架跨越内容、关系和过程,以及将所有三个都视为共同首要的混合形式主义的具体议程。

blocks.en: Every mathematical theory develops around the assumptions and operations it is designed to capture. Thus, we ask: what do intelligent systems actually do with concepts? This operation-based view characterizes concepts by the cognitive and computational operations they support, rather than by their representations alone. This would define the requirements for any mathematics of concepts.
blocks.zh: 每个数学理论都围绕它设计用来捕捉的假设和操作发展. 因此,我们问:智能系统实际上与概念有什么关系? 这种基于操作的观点通过他们支持的认知和计算操作来描述概念,而不是仅仅通过它们的表达来描述. 这将界定任何概念数学的要求。

blocks.en: 2.1 Fundamental Conceptual Operations
blocks.zh: 2.1 基本概念操作

blocks.en: Table 1 introduces the 13 concept operations we identified to recur independently across comparative cognition, cognitive psychology, and AI. Although these traditions differ substantially in their methods, assumptions, and explanatory goals, they repeatedly converge on a common set of capabilities that concepts enable across intelligent systems. 1 1 1 We do not claim that these operations form a complete or final taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 表1介绍了我们确定的13项概念操作,这些操作在比较认知、认知心理学和AI之间独立重复。 虽然这些传统在方法、假设和解释性目标方面差别很大,但它们一再凝聚在一套共同的能力上,使概念能够跨越各种智能系统。 1 11,我们并不声称这些行动构成完整或最后的分类。

blocks.en: Consider the concept zebra : Abstraction extracts features shared across particular zebras, such as their characteristic stripe pattern, while discarding incidental detail such as which zoo or habitat they are observed in; analogy maps the relation between horse and zebra onto the relation between dog and wolf , a domesticated-to-wild correspondence; categorization assigns a new instance to the zebra category (e.g., a new zebra at the local zoo); communication allows the word “zebra” to reliably evoke the same concept in a listener as in the speaker; composition combines the simpler concepts horse and stripes into zebra , such that the meaning of the whole is predictable from its parts; contextualization changes its interpretation across uses such as an actual zebra versus a “zebra crossing”; discrimination distinguishes zebra from the closely confusable concept horse ; generalization applies zebra to a previously unseen subspecies, such as the imperial zebra; grounding connects the concept to sensory experience of actual zebras encountered in the world (the way they feel, smell, etc.); inference derives that a particular zebra is a herbivore from its membership in zebra , without observing this directly; learning acquires the concept zebra in the first place from repeated exposure to instances, for example through picture books or zoo visits; similarity judges zebra as closer to horse than to giraffe ; and revision updates zebra ’s boundaries on learning that Okapi, despite a very similar stripe pattern, is not a type of zebra .
blocks.zh: 考虑一下斑马的概念: 抽象取出特定斑马共有的特征,如其特有的条纹图案,同时抛弃偶然的细节,如它们所观察到的动物园或栖息地;将马和斑马之间的关系映射到狗和狼之间的关系上,一种驯化的对白;分类将新的实例分配给斑马类别(如当地动物园的新斑马);通信允许“斑马”一词在听众中可靠地引出相同的概念;组成将较简单的概念马和条纹结合到斑马身上,从而使整体的含义从其部位可预见;在实际斑马与“斑马交叉”等用途上,背景变化其解释;歧视将斑马与近似的概念马区分开;将斑马适用于以前所见的亚种;将“斑马”一词与世界上实际斑马的感受经验联系起来(它们的感觉、嗅觉等),这种概念与斑马的类似;在马身上直接学习一种特殊的斑马类图案,即不通过对马类图案进行类似。

blocks.en: 3 Evaluating Mathematical Frameworks
blocks.zh: 3 评价数学框架

blocks.en: The multifaceted nature of concepts suggests that mathematical frameworks will exhibit systematic strengths and weaknesses across conceptual operations. We test this hypothesis by comparing ten existing mathematical languages using the operations framework introduced above. Appendix B summarizes each framework’s assumptions, mathematical objects, constructions, and philosophy.
blocks.zh: 概念的多面性表明,数学框架将在概念操作中表现出系统的优缺点。 我们用上面介绍的操作框架来比较现有的十种数学语言来测试这个假设. 附 录 B总结了每个框架的假设,数学对象,构造和哲学.

blocks.en: But mathematical frameworks do not only differ in how well they support a given operation; they differ in what kind of commitment they make about a concept in the first place. Some languages treat a concept as a self-contained object, defined by its content independent of other concepts, as in a vector or a probability distribution. Others treat a concept as inherently relational, defined by its connections and compositions with other concepts, as in a graph or a logical predicate. Others define concepts by how they emerge, adapt, or stabilize through interaction, as in a dynamical system or a game-theoretic equilibrium. This reflects a prior choice about the basic unit of analysis, which, in turn, constrains the operations a framework can express support.
blocks.zh: 但数学框架不仅在它们支持特定操作的程度上有所不同;它们最初对一个概念的承诺种类也有所不同。 一些语言将一个概念视为自成一体的对象,由它的内容独立于其他概念来定义,如在矢量或概率分布中. 另一些则将一个概念视为内在的关系,由它与其他概念的联系和组成来定义,如在图中或逻辑上游. 其他概念则通过互动方式,如动态系统或游戏理论平衡,来定义概念的产生,适应或稳定. 这反映了对基本分析单位的事先选择,这反过来又限制了一个框架能够表达支持的行动。

blocks.en: This distinction organizes the frameworks into three groups: content frameworks , which characterize concepts by their standalone properties (§ 4 ); relational frameworks , which characterize concepts by their connections to other concepts (§ 5 ); and process frameworks , which characterize concepts by how they change over time or through interaction (§ 6 ). Comparing frameworks within each group reveals complementary strengths that share a common commitment (e.g., Geometry and Probability both treat concepts as standalone entities, but emphasize different aspects of their content); comparing across groups reveals deeper tradeoffs. Table 2 provides an overview, and the following sections examine each group and framework in turn.
blocks.zh: 这种区分将框架分为三组:内容框架,其特征是概念的独立属性(§4);关系框架,其特征是概念与其他概念的联系(§5);进程框架,其特征是概念如何随时间变化或通过互动变化(§6)。 各组内部的比较框架显示出具有共同承诺的互补优势(例如,几何和概率都把概念视为独立的实体,但强调其内容的不同方面);各组之间的比较显示出更深层次的权衡。 表2提供了概览,以下各节依次审查了每一组和框架。

The operational perspective reveals complementary strengths rather than a single universally superior mathematical language. A framework naturally supports an operation when the operation is represented by a canonical construction with minimal additional representational assumptions. This does not imply that other frameworks cannot implement the operation. See explanation of the rankings in Appendix A . blocks.en: 4 How Are Concepts Represented on Their Own?
blocks.zh: 4 概念如何代表他们自己?

blocks.en: Some mathematical languages characterize a concept primarily by what it is in isolation. A vector, a probability distribution, or a compressed code all specify a concept’s content on its own terms , prior to any explicit connection to other concepts. We group these together as content frameworks : geometric, probabilistic, and information-theoretic representations. As we show below, each captures a different notion of conceptual content, be it position, uncertainty, or compression, but all treat the concept as a standalone object rather than a node embedded in a network of relations.
blocks.zh: 一些数学语言将概念的特征主要表现为它处于孤立状态. 矢量、概率分布或压缩码在与其他概念有明确联系之前,都以自己的条件规定一个概念的内容。 我们把这些归类为内容框架:几何、概率和信息理论表述。 如下文所示,每个概念都捕捉到概念内容的不同概念,无论是位置,不确定性,还是压缩,但都把概念当作一个独立的对象,而不是嵌入在关系网络中的节点.

blocks.en: 4.1 Geometric Representations
blocks.zh: 4.1 几何表示法

blocks.en: Geometric representations, including vector spaces and embedding models, are among the most widely used mathematical languages for representing concepts in modern AI. Their primary strength is expressing concepts through spatial relationships. Similarity, interpolation, clustering, and analogical reasoning emerge naturally from geometric structure, allowing concepts to vary continuously while preserving meaningful neighborhoods. Subspaces further capture shared features and variation, supporting efficient learning and generalization from high-dimensional data.
blocks.zh: 几何表示法,包括矢量空间和嵌入模型,是现代AI中用于代表概念的最广泛使用的数学语言之一. 它们的主要力量是通过空间关系表达概念. 相似性,内插,集群,和类比推理自然地从几何结构中出现,允许概念在保留有意义的邻里的同时不断变化. 子空间进一步捕捉到共享的特征和变异,支持从高维数据中高效学习和概括.

blocks.en: However, geometric structure alone does not specify how conceptual representations are composed, grounded, or manipulated in reasoning . Vector arithmetic captures simple compositional regularities, such as analogy completion, but more complex composition typically requires learned operations or additional structure. Communication, grounding, and inference likewise are not primitive to geometric representations and must be built into the system. Geometry therefore provides a flexible foundation for conceptual relationships and continuous variation, while leaving the mechanisms of structured reasoning underdetermined.
blocks.zh: 然而,仅几何结构并不能说明概念表述是如何构成、基于或操纵推理的。 矢量算术捕捉简单的组成规律,如类比完成,但更复杂的组成通常需要学习操作或附加结构. 通信、定位和推断对几何表示也并非原始的,必须纳入系统。 因此,几何学为概念关系和持续变异提供了灵活的基础,同时使结构推理机制没有确定。

blocks.en: 4.2 Probabilistic Representations
blocks.zh: 4.2 概率代表

blocks.en: Probabilistic frameworks represent concepts through uncertainty. Instead of asking how similar two concepts are, they ask how likely observations, hypotheses, or conceptual assignments are given available evidence. This naturally supports reasoning under uncertainty, evidence accumulation, Bayesian updating, and prediction; operations that are indispensable whenever concepts must be inferred from incomplete or noisy observations, and that probabilistic models handle through principled mechanisms for combining evidence and adapting beliefs as new information arrives.
blocks.zh: 概率框架通过不确定性代表概念。 他们不问两个概念如何相似,而是问如何提供可能的意见、假设或概念性转让。 这自然支持不确定性下的推理、证据积累、巴耶斯更新和预测;每当概念必须从不完整或吵闹的观察中推断出来时,这些操作都是不可或缺的,而概率模型则通过原则机制,在新信息到达时将证据综合起来并调整信念。

blocks.en: Their limitations arise elsewhere. While probability offers an elegant language for uncertainty, it provides comparatively little structure for expressing compositional relationships or higher-order conceptual organization. Abstraction and symbolic reasoning must therefore be introduced independently of the probabilistic formalism itself.
blocks.zh: 它们的局限性在其他地方出现。 虽然概率为不确定性提供了一个优雅的语言,但它为表达组成关系或更高顺序的概念组织提供了相对较少的结构. 因此,抽象和象征性推理必须独立于概率形式主义本身。

blocks.en: 4.3 Information-Theoretic Representations
blocks.zh: 4.3 信息理论 代表

blocks.en: Information theory approaches concepts in terms of the information they preserve or discard. Conceptual abstraction becomes a problem of compression: identifying representations that retain behaviorally relevant distinctions while eliminating unnecessary detail.
blocks.zh: 信息理论在它们保存或丢弃的信息方面接近概念. 概念抽象成为压缩问题:识别保留行为相关区分,同时消除不必要的细节的表述.

blocks.en: This perspective naturally supports operations such as abstraction and invariant representation learning, and has become influential in neuroscience and ML, where it provides normative accounts of why intelligent systems develop compressed representations.
blocks.zh: 这种视角自然支持抽象和无常的表达学习等操作,在神经科学和ML中也变得有影响力,它提供了智能系统为何会发展压缩表达的规范说法.

blocks.en: Its principal limitation is that information theory is largely agnostic about the internal organization of conceptual representations . It can characterize what information is preserved for reasoning, but does not specify the conceptual relationships or operations needed to compose and manipulate that information. Information theory therefore provides powerful principles for optimizing representations without fully specifying the representations and operations that support reasoning.
blocks.zh: 其主要局限在于信息理论对概念表述的内部组织基本上不可知. 它可以描述哪些信息被保存下来进行推理,但并没有具体说明构思和操纵这些信息所需的概念关系或操作. 因此,信息理论为优化表述提供了强有力的原则,但没有充分具体说明支持推理的表述和业务.

blocks.en: 5 How Do Concepts Relate to Other Concepts?
blocks.zh: 5 概念与其他概念的关系如何?

blocks.en: Other mathematical languages characterize a concept primarily by how it relates to and combines with other concepts. Logical systems, graphs, algebraic structures, and category theory all treat relations, composition, and structure-preserving mappings as the primary explanatory unit, so that a concept matters mainly through its position within a larger relational system. We group these as relational frameworks . As we show below, each emphasizes a different kind of relational structure, be it inference, connectivity, closure, or composition, but all share this shift from content to relation.
blocks.zh: 其他数学语言主要通过这一概念如何与其他概念联系和结合来描述这一概念。 逻辑系统,图表,代数结构,和类理论都把关系,组成,结构保留绘图作为主要解释单位,这样一个概念就主要通过它在更大的关系体系中的地位而重要. 我们把这些归类为关系框架。 如下文所示,每个组织都强调不同种类的关系结构,无论是推论,连通性,闭合性,还是组成性,但都认同从内容到关系的这种转变.

blocks.en: 5.1 Logical Representations
blocks.zh: 5.1 逻辑陈述

blocks.en: Logical systems represent concepts through symbolic predicates, relations, and formal rules. Their strength is explicit inference: deduction, consistency checking, explanation, and rule composition support transparent derivation of complex conclusions.
blocks.zh: 逻辑系统通过象征性的上游,关系,和正式规则来代表概念. 其优点是明确的推论:扣减、一致性检查、解释和规则构成有助于透明地得出复杂的结论。

blocks.en: This explicit structure makes logical representations particularly attractive for domains requiring interpretability, formal guarantees, or precise symbolic reasoning. Unlike geometric approaches, logical derivations can be traced step by step, with each inference interpretable on its own terms.
blocks.zh: 这种明确的结构使得逻辑表述对需要解释性、正式保证或精确的象征性推理的领域特别有吸引力。 与几何方法不同,逻辑推论可以一步步地追溯,每个推论都可以按照自己的术语解释.

blocks.en: Their principal weakness is that concepts rarely have purely discrete boundaries. Human concepts are graded, context-dependent, and often ambiguous, properties that classical logic does not capture naturally. Similarity, continuous variation, and statistical learning therefore require substantial extensions beyond the logical formalism itself.
blocks.zh: 它们的主要弱点是概念很少有纯粹的离散边界。 人类的概念被分级,依赖上下文,而且往往模糊不清,古典逻辑不能自然捕捉到的属性. 因此,相似性、持续变化和统计学学习需要大大扩展,超越逻辑形式主义本身。

blocks.en: 5.2 Graph-based Representations
blocks.zh: 5.2 基于图表的说明

blocks.en: Graphs organize concepts through explicit relationships. Rather than emphasizing individual concepts, they focus on the network of connections among them. Hierarchies, dependencies, taxonomies, and semantic networks therefore emerge naturally within graph structures.
blocks.zh: 图表通过明确的关系来组织概念. 它们不强调个别概念,而是侧重于它们之间的联系网络。 因此,等级、依赖、分类和语义网络在图表结构中自然出现。

blocks.en: This relational perspective supports operations such as navigation, relational reasoning, and structural organization: traversing paths, computing shortest connections, or aggregating over neighborhoods all fall out naturally from graph structure. Knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic networks exemplify this approach across AI and cognitive science.
blocks.zh: 这种关系视角支持导航,关系推理,以及结构组织等操作: 穿梭路径,计算最短的连接,或者聚集在邻里上,都自然地从图表结构中脱落出来. 知识图,本体学,语义网络在AI和认知科学中都体现了这种方法.

blocks.en: However, graphs alone provide limited mechanisms for representing graded similarity, uncertainty, or abstraction . While relationships are explicit, the representations themselves generally require complementary mathematical tools to support graded similarity or probabilistic inference.
blocks.zh: 然而,仅图表就提供了有限的机制来代表等级相似性、不确定性或抽象性。 虽然关系是明确的,但表述本身一般需要辅助数学工具来支持等级相似性或概率推论.

blocks.en: 5.3 Algebraic Representations
blocks.zh: 5.3 代数代表

blocks.en: Algebra characterizes concepts through operations and the rules governing their composition, focusing on the structural properties preserved when concepts are combined or transformed. Mathematical objects such as groups, semigroups, lattices, and Boolean algebras provide formal languages for expressing compositional structure, symmetry, and closure.
blocks.zh: 代数通过操作和规范其构成的规则来描述概念,侧重于概念合并或转变时保留的结构属性. 组,半组,lattices,和布尔代数等数学对象为表达组成结构,对称,和闭合提供了正式语言.

blocks.en: This perspective naturally supports operations involving composition, decomposition, symmetry, equivalence, and hierarchical organization. Algebraic methods have long influenced symbolic AI, formal concept analysis, and knowledge representation, offering a principled calculus for building complex conceptual structures from simple ones.
blocks.zh: 这种观点自然支持涉及组成、分解、对称、等同和等级组织的业务。 代数方法长期以来影响了象征性的AI,形式的概念分析,以及知识的体现,为从简单的概念结构中构建复杂的概念结构提供了原则的计算.

blocks.en: At the same time, algebra typically abstracts away continuous variation, uncertainty, and learning dynamics . While it provides powerful structural constraints, additional mathematical machinery is often required to capture graded similarity, probabilistic reasoning, or adaptation from data.
blocks.zh: 同时,代数通常将持续变异、不确定性和学习动态推开。 虽然它提供了强大的结构制约,但往往需要额外的数学机械来捕捉分级的相似性,概率推理,或从数据中调适.

blocks.en: 5.4 Category-Theoretic Representations
blocks.zh: 5.4 类别 -- -- 理论代表

blocks.en: Category theory treats transformations, rather than objects, as primary, asking how concepts relate through structure-preserving mappings. This makes operations such as composition, abstraction, translation between representations, and structural analogy particularly natural. Universal constructions provide principled notions of abstraction, while functors formalize systematic correspondences between representational systems. In contrast to other frameworks, category theory emphasizes interoperability across mathematical structures.
blocks.zh: 类别理论将变换,而不是物体作为主,询问概念如何通过结构保留绘图来联系. 这使得构成,抽象,表达之间的翻译,结构类比等操作变得特别自然. 普世构思提供了抽象的原则概念,而functors则将代表体系之间的系统对应正式化. 与其他框架不同,类别理论强调跨数学结构的互操作性.

blocks.en: This generality, however, is also its principal limitation. Category theory provides a language for relating structures rather than prescribing the structures themselves. Operations such as similarity, uncertainty, grounding, and learning require additional categorical constructions and domain-specific assumptions to become computationally meaningful. Category theory is therefore well suited to organizing conceptual operations across otherwise disparate formalisms, but does not by itself provide the content- or process-oriented commitments those formalisms capture.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种笼统性也是其主要限制。 类别理论为相关结构提供了一种语言,而不是规定结构本身。 相似性、不确定性、地面定位和学习等操作需要额外的绝对构思和特定领域的假设才能在计算上有意义。 因此,类别理论非常适合组织不同形式的概念行动,但本身并不能提供这些形式主义所抓住的内容或过程导向的承诺。

blocks.en: 6 How Do Concepts Emerge and Evolve?
blocks.zh: 6 概念的产生和演变如何?

blocks.en: A third group of mathematical languages characterizes concepts not by their content or relations, but by how they emerge, adapt, and stabilize over time. Dynamical systems, optimization, and game theory all treat concepts as outcomes of an ongoing process, whether driven by temporal dynamics, adaptation to an objective, or strategic interaction among agents, rather than as fixed content or fixed relational structure. We group these as process frameworks . Each captures a different driver of conceptual change, but all share this emphasis on concepts as evolving rather than static.
blocks.zh: 第三组数学语言的特征不是从内容或关系上,而是从概念的出现、适应和随着时间推移而稳定起来。 动态系统,优化,游戏理论都将概念视为一个持续过程的结果,无论是时间动态驱动,还是适应目标,还是代理人之间的战略互动,而不是固定的内容或固定的关系结构. 我们把这些归类为进程框架。 每个概念都抓住了不同的概念变化驱动力,但都强调概念是不断发展的,而不是静止的。

blocks.en: 6.1 Dynamical Systems
blocks.zh: 6.1 动态系统

blocks.en: Dynamical systems view concepts not as static representations but as states that evolve over time according to underlying dynamics, asking how conceptual states emerge, stabilize, and transform through interaction with their environment. Such models naturally describe attractors, trajectories, bifurcations, and other temporal phenomena that characterize adaptive behavior.
blocks.zh: 动态系统将概念看成不是静态表示,而是随时间推移而根据基本动态演变的状态,询问概念状态是如何通过与环境的互动而出现、稳定和转变的。 这种模型自然地描述了吸引者,轨迹,双鱼座,以及其他具有适应行为特征的时间现象.

blocks.en: This perspective makes operations such as concept acquisition, conceptual change, and contextual adaptation particularly natural, and extends naturally to memory (as persistent or recurring states) and sequential reasoning (as trajectories through state space). It has therefore become increasingly influential in neuroscience, cognitive science, and ML, where intelligence is often modeled as a continuously evolving process rather than a sequence of discrete computations.
blocks.zh: 这种视角使得诸如概念获取,概念变化,以及背景适应等操作特别自然,自然延伸至记忆(作为持续状态或反复状态)和顺序推理(作为穿越状态空间的轨迹). 因此,它在神经科学,认知科学和ML中的影响越来越大,在那里,智能常常被建模为一个不断演变的过程,而不是一个离散计算序列.

blocks.en: However, dynamical systems provide comparatively little structure for representing explicit symbolic relationships, compositional reasoning, or semantic hierarchies . They excel at describing how conceptual systems evolve, but less naturally express what conceptual structures are.
blocks.zh: 然而,动态系统为代表明确的象征关系、组成推理或语义等级提供了相对较少的结构。 它们擅长描述概念系统是如何演变的,但不太自然地表达什么是概念结构。

blocks.en: 6.2 Optimization-Based Representations
blocks.zh: 6.2 基于优化的代表性

blocks.en: Optimization approaches concepts as outcomes of objectives optimized under constraints. Concepts emerge because they support efficient prediction, decision making, communication, compression, or other task goals.
blocks.zh: 优化将概念视为在制约因素下优化的目标成果。 概念的出现是由于它们支持高效的预测,决策,通信,压缩或其他任务目标.

blocks.en: This perspective naturally supports learning, adaptation, generalization, and trade-offs between competing objectives. In modern ML, conceptual representations often emerge implicitly from loss functions, inductive biases, and training dynamics.
blocks.zh: 这种观点自然支持相互竞争的目标之间的学习、适应、概括和权衡。 在现代的ML中,概念表述往往从损失函数、诱导偏差和培训动态中隐含产生。

blocks.en: Its principal limitation is that optimization alone says little about the internal structure of concepts. Similarity, composition, inference, and abstraction depend on the representational framework being optimized, not on optimization itself. Optimization therefore complements, rather than replaces, frameworks for representing and manipulating concepts.
blocks.zh: 其主要局限在于,仅优化就很少提到概念的内部结构。 相似性,构成,推论,抽象等取决于代表框架的优化,而不是优化自身. 因此,优化而不是取代代表和管理概念的框架。

blocks.en: 6.3 Game-Theoretic Representations
blocks.zh: 6.3 游戏-理论表现

blocks.en: Game theory studies concepts in the context of strategic interaction among multiple agents. It emphasizes the roles concepts play in collective behavior: how meanings emerge, evolve, and stabilize through communication, cooperation, competition, and negotiation.
blocks.zh: 游戏理论在多个代理人的战略互动背景下研究概念. 它强调概念在集体行为中的作用:通过沟通、合作、竞争和谈判如何产生、演变和稳定意义。

blocks.en: This perspective naturally supports operations involving communication, coordination, pragmatic inference, convention formation, and social grounding. It provides a principled framework for understanding how shared conceptual systems arise, adapt, and persist within populations of interacting agents, making it relevant to both human cognition and multi-agent AI.
blocks.zh: 这种观点自然支持涉及沟通、协调、务实推论、公约形成和社会基础的行动。 它提供了一个原则框架,用以了解共同的概念体系如何在相互作用的代理人群体中产生、适应和持续,使之与人类认知和多代理人AI相关。

blocks.en: Its principal limitation is its emphasis on interaction rather than internal representation. Game theory provides limited guidance for representing conceptual structure, similarity, or compositional reasoning within individual agents. It therefore complements representational frameworks by explaining how concepts function and evolve through social interaction.
blocks.zh: 其主要局限在于强调互动而不是内部代表性。 游戏理论为代表概念结构,相似性,或个体代理内部的构成推理提供了有限的指导. 因此,它通过解释概念如何通过社会互动发挥作用和演变来补充代表性框架。

blocks.en: 7 Categorization Test-Case
blocks.zh: 7 分类测试案例

blocks.en: To better illustrate how different mathematical frameworks answer questions about concept operations, we ask each framework the same question: how would this concept be categorized? . We use a human categorization judgments dataset from Shani et al. (2026) . Categorization is a useful test case because almost every framework has something to say about it, yet they view the operation differently. We explore nine frameworks, excluding game theory, which does not naturally support categorization (Table 2 ). For each, we implement the corresponding procedure on the same items and compare its output against the same human judgments.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地说明不同的数学框架如何回答关于概念操作的问题,我们向每个框架提出同样的问题:这一概念如何分类? 我们使用来自Shani等人(2026年)的人类分类判断数据集。 分类是一个有用的测试案例,因为几乎每个框架都对此有话要说,然而他们对操作的看法却有所不同. 我们探索了9个框架,不包括游戏理论,这些框架自然不会支持分类(表2 ). 对于每个项目,我们执行相同的程序,并将其产出与同样的人类判断进行比较。

blocks.en: Geometry treats a category as a region and clusters by Euclidean distance. Probability models each category as a class-conditional density and assigns by posterior. Optimization treats categorization as empirical risk minimization and fits a discriminative probe. Information uses the Information Bottleneck ( Tishby et al., 2000 ) , compressing items while preserving a relevance variable. Logic defines a category by features necessary and jointly sufficient for membership. Algebra builds the Galois concept lattice over items and their features ( Ganter et al., 1999 ) . Graph clusters by shortest-path distance in a knowledge graph; Structural clusters by structural equivalence in that graph, discarding node identity. Dynamical treats a category as an attractor and measures how stable an item’s representation is across training checkpoints. Table 5 summarizes the operationalizations and results.
blocks.zh: 几何学用欧几里得距离将一个类别当作一个区域和集群. 概率模型每个类别作为类条件密度,由后人指定. 优化将分类视为实证风险最小化,适合歧视性调查。 信息使用Information Bottleneck(Tishby等人,2000年),在保留相关变量的同时压缩项目. 逻辑定义一个类别,其特征对成员资格来说是必要和共同的。 代数在物品及其特征上构建了加洛瓦概念(Ganter等人,1999年)。 以知识图中最短路径距离表示的图组; 该图中结构等效的结构组,丢弃节点身份. 动态将某一类别视为一个吸引者,并衡量某一物项在训练检查站之间的代表性是否稳定。 表5汇总了运作情况和成果。

blocks.en: Every method returns a partition of the items, scored against the human partition. When a method admits a choice of cluster number, we set it to the number of human categories, preventing any method from benefiting from its own granularity. Methods that require fitting use nested cross-validation grouped by item, so no item appears in both training and test folds. We report Adjusted Rand Index and Adjusted Mutual Information, both corrected for chance agreement, alongside uncorrected NMI, with confidence intervals obtained by subsampling items, and Accuracy for trained methods with Matched Accuracy for all methods (on the same held-out set). Matched accuracy is cluster accuracy after optimal Hungarian matching to the human categories. Each procedure is tested against a null matched to its confounds: initialization for clustering, checkpoint order for trajectories, and information-budget variation for relevance comparisons. Full methodological details and additional metrics are provided in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 每一种方法都返回物品的分区,得分与人类分区相对. 当一种方法承认选择群数时,我们把它设定为人类类别的数目,防止任何方法从自己的颗粒性中获益. 按项目分类,需要适当使用嵌入式交叉验证的方法,因此在培训和测试折叠中都没有项目。 我们报告经过调整的Rand指数和经过调整的相互信息,两者都经过修正,以便达成机会协议,加上未经修正的NMI,通过分样项目获得的置信间隔,以及对所有方法(按相同的预留办法)采用经过培训的方法的精确度。 匹配的精度是在匈牙利人与人类类别进行最佳匹配之后的集群精度. 每项程序都要对照与其混杂之处相对应的无效情况进行测试:集群初始化、轨迹检查点命令以及用于关联性比较的信息-预算差异。 附录B.1提供了完整的方法细节和其他衡量标准。

blocks.en: Table 3: Categorization performance across mathematical frameworks. Support indicates the framework’s theoretical support for categorization (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 表3:各数学框架的分类性能。 支助表明框架对分类的理论支持(表2)。

blocks.en: 7.1 Quantitative interpretation
blocks.zh: 7.1 定量解释

blocks.en: The methods differ in ways that cannot be fully equalized. Three of the nine are supervised and use category labels during fitting, so their predictive scores are not directly comparable to the six unsupervised methods. The methods also require different auxiliary resources and therefore cover different subsets of the items: the knowledge graph covers nearly all items, whereas property norms cover 60-76%. Finally, predictive accuracy is defined only for the supervised methods; for the others, we report cluster accuracy after optimal matching, which measures agreement with the human partition under a different criterion. We therefore do not interpret Table 5 as a ranking.
blocks.zh: 方法不同,不能完全等同。 9人中有3人被监督,在安装时使用类别标签,因此他们的预测分数不能直接与6个无监督方法相比. 这些方法还需要不同的辅助资源,因此涵盖项目的不同子集:知识图涵盖几乎所有项目,而财产规范涵盖60-76%。 最后,预测准确性的定义只针对被监督的方法;对其他方法,我们报告在最佳匹配之后的集群准确性,该组合在不同的标准下衡量与人类分区的一致. 因此,我们不把表5解释为排名。

blocks.en: These scores indicate how well each operationalization recovers the human category structure under its particular mathematical commitments and input representation. Thus, a low score is evidence that the corresponding operationalization provides a poor account of human categorization in this setting, although it does not by itself identify whether the limitation lies in the mathematical framework, its representation, its auxiliary data, or its implementation. Conversely, higher recovery provides evidence that the framework captures aspects of categorization reflected in the human judgments.
blocks.zh: 这些分数表明,在具体数学承诺和投入表述下,每次操作如何恢复人类类别结构。 因此,较低的分数表明,相应的可操作性在此情况下对人类分类的描述不佳,尽管它本身并不能确定限制在于数学框架、其表述、其辅助数据还是其实施。 相反,较高的回收率提供证据表明,该框架涵盖了人类判决中所反映的分类方面。

blocks.en: The two highest-performing methods are supervised, consistent with the advantage of access to category labels during fitting. Among the non-supervised methods, the strongest performers are those classified as ✓ in Table 2 , suggesting that frameworks that naturally support categorization also tend to provide stronger accounts of human category structure when instantiated on this task.
blocks.zh: 两种最高性能的方法都受到监督,这符合在安装期间访问类别标签的好处。 在不受监督的方法中,表现最强的是表2中被列为“______________________________”的方法,这表明自然支持分类的框架在对这项任务进行即决时,也倾向于更有力地说明人类类别的结构。

blocks.en: We next examine crowbar , a Carpenter’s Tool in the human data and the item on which the nine mathematical implementations disagree most. It receives seven distinct majority categories, and the average overlap between the sets of items with which it is grouped is only 0.14 0.14 (see Appendix B.2 ). The four embedding-based accounts place it among birds, the property-norm accounts place it among weapons, and the knowledge-graph account assigns it no coherent neighborhood.

blocks.en: The embedding-based error has a sub-lexical origin. Under mean pooling, cos ⁡ ( ​ c ​ r ​ o ​ w ​ b ​ a ​ r , ​ c ​ r ​ o ​ w ) = 0.735 \cos(\emph{crowbar},\emph{crow})=0.735 , and nine of its ten nearest neighbors are birds, while its similarity to other tools does not exceed 0.32 0.32 . The compound therefore inherits the neighborhood of its leading subword, an effect also visible in pairs such as sim (blackberry, blackjack)= 0.719 0.719 . This example also reveals a limitation of apparent convergence across methods. The four embedding-based accounts agree because they share the same input representation and its associated bias, so their agreement is not four independent pieces of evidence. Conversely, disagreement across methods using different representations can reveal which source of evidence drives an error, something an aggregate score obscures.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusions & Future Work
blocks.zh: 8 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We have argued that a mathematics of concepts should be organized around the operations concepts support, such as similarity, composition, generalization, grounding, and revision, rather than around a mathematical framework. Comparing ten mathematical frameworks through this lens shows that each makes different conceptual operations natural, reflecting different commitments to conceptual content, relational structure, and process. No framework in our comparison naturally supports the full set of operations, suggesting that a mathematics of concepts will likely require combining complementary mathematical frameworks rather than refining a single one .
blocks.zh: 我们主张,概念的数学应围绕行动概念的支持,如相似性、组成、概括性、基础和修订,而不是围绕数学框架。 通过这个透镜比较十个数学框架,可以发现,每个都使不同的概念操作自然化,反映了对概念内容,关系结构,和过程的不同承诺. 我们比较中没有任何一个框架自然支持整套操作,表明概念的数学可能要求结合互补的数学框架,而不是完善单一的数学框架。

blocks.en: Our categorization experiment provides an initial empirical test of this framework. The results suggest that the theoretical notion of natural support is not merely descriptive: among non-supervised methods, the frameworks classified as naturally supporting categorization achieve the strongest recovery of human category structure. At the same time, supervised methods can achieve higher performance by introducing information that is not native to the framework. The results therefore suggest a useful distinction between native mathematical support and performance through added machinery : a framework’s mathematical commitments constrain what it can express naturally, while additional supervision, representations, and auxiliary data can extend what it achieves in practice.
blocks.zh: 我们的分类实验对这一框架提供了初步的经验测试。 结果表明,自然支持的理论概念不仅仅是描述性的:在非监督方法中,被归类为自然支持分类的框架实现了人类类别结构最强的恢复. 同时,受监督的方法可以通过引入并非本体的信息来达到更高的性能. 因此,结果表明,通过增加的机制对本地数学支持和性能进行有益的区分:一个框架的数学承诺限制了它能够自然表达的东西,而额外的监督、表述和辅助数据可以扩展它在实践中的成就。

blocks.en: Several directions follow from this framing. First, the empirical analysis should be extended beyond categorization to the broader set of conceptual operations, testing whether the theoretical distinctions in Table 2 predict behavior across tasks and representations. Second, the comparison should be expanded to additional mathematical languages and hybrid formalisms, as well as to a broader and empirically validated taxonomy of conceptual operations. Most importantly, the framework opens a constructive question: can we develop mathematical formalisms that support a broad, human-like range of conceptual operations? We encourage the field to build a mathematical language that makes concepts’ full range of operations explicit.
blocks.zh: 这个框架有好几个方向。 首先,经验分析应该从分类扩大到更广泛的一系列概念操作,检验表2中的理论区分是否预测了跨任务和表达的行为. 第二,应扩大比较范围,使其包括更多的数学语言和混合形式主义,以及概念操作的更广泛和经经验验证的分类。 最重要的是,这个框架开启了一个建设性的问题:我们是否能够发展数学形式主义,支持广泛,类似于人的概念操作范围? 我们鼓励该领域建立一个数学语言,使概念的全部操作范围明确。

blocks.en: Appendix A Rationale for Table 2
blocks.zh: 表2的理由说明

blocks.en: The assignments in Table 2 are based on whether a mathematical framework provides structures or operations that naturally correspond to each conceptual operation. We use three levels of support: naturally supported ( ✓ ) when the operation corresponds to a canonical object or operation of the framework; supported, but not primary ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) when the framework provides relevant mathematical machinery but the operation is not a central object of the framework; and not naturally supported ( × \bm{\times} ) when expressing the operation requires substantial additional assumptions or machinery external to the framework. The rationale for each operation is given below.
blocks.zh: 表2中的任务是基于一个数学框架是否提供与每个概念操作自然对应的结构或操作. 我们使用三个级别的支持:当操作与框架的犬目对象或操作相对应时,自然支持(✓);当框架提供相关的数学机械但操作不是框架的中心对象时,支持但并非初级(∘\bm{\crc});当表示操作需要框架外大量的附加假设或机器时,自然支持(×\bm{\tims}). 每项行动的理由如下。

blocks.en: Abstraction concerns extracting structure that is invariant across particular instances while discarding incidental detail ( Posner and Keele, 1968 ) . Information theory ( ✓ ) naturally supports this through representations that retain relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation ( Cover et al., 1991 ) . Algebra ( ✓ ) and category theory ( ✓ ) provide particularly direct structural forms of abstraction: algebra identifies common structure through abstract operations and axioms ( Cohn, 2003 ; Heinzmann and Petitot, 2020 ) , while category theory abstracts away from the internal details of objects in favor of their relationships and mappings ( Mac Lane and MacLane, 1971 ) . Logic ( ✓ ) also supports abstraction through variables, predicates, quantification, and formal structures that separate general properties from particular instances ( Quine, 1982 ; Collins, ) . Geometry ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support abstraction by identifying invariant geometric structure under transformations ( Martin, 2012 ) . Probability ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can likewise support abstraction by identifying probabilistic structure that remains invariant under transformations or symmetries ( Kallenberg, 2005 ) . Graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) provide abstraction by representing entities and their relations independently of their concrete implementation, and by supporting structural representations that preserve relational patterns while discarding incidental detail ( Battiston et al., 2020 ) , while optimization ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) supports abstraction more indirectly by selecting representations or solutions that preserve task-relevant structure under an explicitly specified objective ( Tishby et al., 2000 ) . Dynamical systems ( × \bm{\times} ) and game-theory ( × \bm{\times} ) do not naturally support abstraction.
blocks.zh: 抽象论涉及抽取的结构,这种结构在特定情况下是变化无常的,而忽略了附带的细节(Posner和Keele,1968年)。 信息理论( )通过保留相关信息而抛弃无关的变异的表述自然支持这一点(Cover等人,1991年)。 代数( )和类理论(✓)提供了特别直接的抽象结构形式:代数通过抽象操作和定理来识别共同结构(Cohn,2003;Heinzmann and Petitot,2020),而类理论摘要则远离对象的内部细节,有利于它们的关系和映射(Mac Lane and MacLane,1971). 逻辑( )也支持通过变量,上游,量化,以及将一般属性与特定实例区分开的正式结构进行抽象(Quine,1982;Collins,). 几何学(\\bm\circ})可以通过在变换中识别不定几何结构来支持抽象(Martin, 2012). 概率(\\\bm\circ})同样可以通过识别在变换或对称下仍然不稳定的概率结构来支持抽象(Kallenberg, 2005). Graphs (\\bm\circ})通过代表实体及其关系而提供抽象,独立于其具体实施,支持结构表达,既保留关系模式,又丢弃附带细节(Battiston等人,2020年),而优化(\\bm\circ})则通过在明确规定的目标下选择保留任务相关结构的表述或解决方案,更间接地支持抽象(Tishby等人,2000年). 动态系统(x\bm\times})和游戏理论(x\bm\times})不自然支持抽象.

blocks.en: Analogy concerns mapping structural relationships from one conceptual domain onto another ( Gentner, 1983 ) . Geometry ( ✓ ) naturally supports analogy through transformations, isometries, correspondences, and mappings between geometric structures ( Martin, 2012 ) . Category theory ( ✓ ) provides an especially direct formal language for structural correspondence through functors and related structure-preserving mappings ( Osherson et al., 1990 ) . Logic ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ), graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ), and algebra ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can express structural correspondences between formal systems through interpretations, homomorphisms, and other structure-preserving mappings ( Enderton, 2001 ; Hell et al., 2026 ; Cohn, 2003 ) . Probability ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) and information theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support analogy through probabilistic or information-theoretic comparisons between domains ( Gibbs and Su, 2002 ; Cover et al., 1991 ) , but these are generally secondary uses. Dynamical systems ( × \bm{\times} ), optimization ( × \bm{\times} ), and game theory ( × \bm{\times} ) do not naturally provide cross-domain structural analogy.
blocks.zh: 分析涉及从一个概念领域到另一个概念领域的结构关系分布(Gentner,1983年)。 几何学( )自然支持通过变换,异位,对应,以及几何结构之间的映射来进行类比(Martin, 2012). Category theory (  ✓ ✓)为通过分光器和相关的结构保存图谱进行结构对应提供了一种特别直接的正式语言(Osherson等人,1990年). 逻辑 (\\bm\circ}),图 (\\bm\circ}),代数 (\\bm\circ}),可以通过解释,同质化,以及其他结构保留映射来表达正式系统之间的结构对应(Enderton,2001年); Hell et al., 2026 ; Cohn, 2003 ). ). 概率(\\bm\circ})和信息理论(\\bm\circ})可以通过概率或信息理论在域之间的比较支持类比(Gibbs和Su,2002年;Cover等人,1991年),但这些通常是次要用途. 动态系统(\\bm\times}),优化(\bm\times}),游戏理论(\bm\times}) 自然不能提供跨域结构类比.

blocks.en: Categorization concerns grouping distinct instances into classes on the basis of shared properties ( Smith and Medin, 1981 ; Murphy and Medin, 1985 ; Rosch and Mervis, 1975 ) . Geometry ( ✓ ) naturally supports categorization through clustering, regions, neighborhoods, and geometric structures ( Mirkin, 2013 ) , and graphs ( ✓ ) support categorization when categories are represented as subgraphs, clusters, or communities ( Martin, 2012 ; Fortunato and others, 2010 ; Hell et al., 2026 ) Probability ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) supports probabilistic class membership and distributions over instances ( Griffiths et al., 2008 ) ; Information theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can characterize category structure through mutual information shared by instances and category variables ( Cover et al., 1991 ) . Logic ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) provides predicates that can define classes and formal distinctions, while equivalence relations provide a canonical mathematical mechanism for partitioning objects into classes, although categorization is not itself a central logical operation ( Enderton, 2001 ) . Algebra ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) provides equivalence relations, quotient structures, and subalgebras that can partition objects into classes ( Cohn, 2003 ) ; Category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) organizes objects through morphisms and structural relationships, allowing objects with shared structural properties to be grouped or identified up to isomorphism ( Mac Lane and MacLane, 1971 ) . Dynamical systems ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can partition state spaces into regions with qualitatively similar trajectories or asymptotic behavior ( Strogatz, 2024 ) . Optimization ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support categorization when category membership is formulated as an optimization or decision problem, but this requires an additional objective or loss function ( Hart et al., 2001 ) . Game theory ( × \bm{\times} ) does not naturally provide categorization as a mathematical primitive.
blocks.zh: 分类涉及根据共享属性将不同实例分类(Smith and Medin,1981年;Murphy and Medin,1985年;Rosch and Mervis,1975年)。 2010; Hell et al., 2026) 概率(\\bm\circ}) 支持概率阶级成员制和案例分布(Griffiths et al., 2008) 信息理论(\\bm\circ})可以通过实例和类别变量共享的相互信息来描述类别结构(Cover et al., 1991). 逻辑 (\\\bm\circ}) 提供了可以定义类和形式区分的上游,而等同关系则提供了将对象分割成类的犬形数学机制,尽管分类本身并不是中心逻辑操作(Enderton, 2001). 代数(\\bm\circ})提供等效关系,商数结构,以及可以将对象分割成类的子代数(Cohn,2003);类论(\\bm\circ})通过形态和结构关系组织对象,允许具有共享结构属性的物体被组合或识别到异态(Mac Lane和MacLane,1971). 动态系统(\\\bm\circ})可以将状态空间分割成具有质地相似的轨迹或不对称行为的区域(Stagentz, 2024). 优化(\\bm\circ})可以支持将类别成员构成优化或决定问题时进行分类,但这需要额外的目标或损失函数(Hart等人,2001年)。 游戏理论 (\\bm\times}) 自然不会提供作为数学原始的分类.

blocks.en: Communication concerns the reliable transmission of a concept between agents ( Lazaridou et al., 2017 ) . Information theory ( ✓ ) provides a way to measure information lose during communication ( Cover et al., 1991 ) . Game theory ( ✓ ) provides canonical models of communication through signaling games, cheap-talk models, and strategic information transmission ( Crawford and Sobel, 1982 ) . Category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support formal accounts of communication by representing compositional mappings between structured representational systems, although the communicative interpretation requires additional assumptions about encoding and interpretation ( Coecke et al., 2010 ) . Dynamical systems ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can be adapted such that each system represents an agent’s conceptual representation and communication alters the system ( Strogatz, 2024 ) . Logic ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can represent formal messages, communication protocols, and agents’ knowledge states ( Fagin et al., 1995 ) , while graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can represent communication networks by modeling agents as nodes and communication links as edges, with paths capturing possible routes of information flow ( Newman, 2010 ) . These provide useful machinery, but communication is not itself a primary operation of logic or graph theory. Geometry ( × \bm{\times} ), probability ( × \bm{\times} ), and algebra ( × \bm{\times} ) do not naturally treats inter-agent conceptual transmission as a central operation.
blocks.zh: 通信涉及在代理人之间可靠传递一个概念(Lazaridou等人,2017年). 信息理论( )提供了衡量通信过程中信息损失的方法(Cover等人,1991年)。 游戏理论(QQ)通过信号游戏,廉价谈话模式,以及战略信息传输(Crawford and Sobel, 1982 )提供犬类通信模式. Category ory (\\bm\circ}) 可以通过代表结构化代表体系之间的组成图谱来支持正式的通信叙述,尽管通信解释需要额外的编码和解释假设(Coecke等人,2010年). 动态系统(\\bm\circ})可以进行改造,使每个系统代表一个代理的概念代表,通信改变系统(Stagentz, 2024). 逻辑(\\bm\circ})可以代表正式消息,通信协议,以及代理的知识状态(Fagin等人,1995年),而图(\\bm\circ})可以通过建模代理作为节点和通信连接作为边缘来代表通信网络,路径可以捕捉信息流动的可能路线(Newman,2010年). 这些提供了有用的机制,但通信本身并不是逻辑或图论的主要操作. 几何学(\bm\times}),概率(\bm\times}),代数(\bm\times})不自然地将代理人间概念传递视为中心操作.

blocks.en: Composition concerns combining simpler concepts into a structured whole according to systematic rules ( Fodor and Pylyshyn, 1988 ) . Logic ( ✓ ) provides canonical compositional operations through logical connectives and the recursive construction of well-formed expressions ( Quine, 1982 ) . Algebra ( ✓ ) provides composition through binary operations and algebraic structures ( Cohn, 2003 ) , while category theory ( ✓ ) makes composition of morphisms a foundational operation ( Mac Lane and MacLane, 1971 ) . Graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) support composition through graph products, substitution, and other graph-combination operations, but composition is not as fundamental as it is in algebra or category theory ( Hell et al., 2026 ) . Geometry ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can represent composite structures through geometric construction and composition of simpler configurations, but composition is secondary to its focus on geometric structure and invariance ( Borsuk, 2018 ) . Probability ( × \bm{\times} ), information theory ( × \bm{\times} ), dynamical systems ( × \bm{\times} ), optimization ( × \bm{\times} ), and game theory ( × \bm{\times} ) can be used in compositional models but do not themselves make conceptual composition a primary mathematical operation.
blocks.zh: 组成问题涉及根据系统规则将较简单的概念合并为一个结构化的整体(Fodor和Pylyshyn,1988年)。 逻辑( )通过逻辑连接和成形表达式的递归构造(Quine, 1982)提供犬形成分操作. 代数( )通过二进制操作和代数结构提供组成(Cohn,2003年),而类别理论(✓)使形态学的构成成为基础操作(Mac Lane and MacLane,1971年). Graphs (\\bm\circ}) 通过图产品,替代,以及其他图集操作支持组成,但组成不如代数或类别理论中的基本(Hell等人,2026年). 几何(\\bm\circ})可以通过几何构造和较简单的构型的构成来代表复合结构,但组成对于其注重几何结构与偏差是次要的(Borsuk, 2018). 概率(x\bm\times}),信息理论(x\bm\times}),动态系统(x\bm\times}),优化(x\bm\times}),游戏理论(x\bm\times})可以用于组成模型,但本身并不使概念构成成为主要数学操作.

blocks.en: Contextualization concerns systematic changes in the meaning or applicability of a concept as surrounding circumstances change ( Barsalou, 1982 ) . Probability ( ✓ ) naturally supports contextual dependence through conditional distributions and conditional probabilities such as Markov decision processes ( Jaynes and Bretthorst, 2003 ) . Dynamical systems ( ✓ ) provide a direct representation of state-dependent behavior, in which the current state changes the system’s subsequent evolution ( Strogatz, 2024 ) . Game theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) represents how an agent’s available actions and payoffs depend on the strategic context created by other agents, although contextualized meaning is not its primary object ( Osborne and Rubinstein, 1994 ) . Information theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can represent contextual dependence directly through conditional entropy, conditional mutual information, and related conditional measures ( Cover et al., 1991 ) . Other frameworks support contextual dependence through additional structural constructions: geometry ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) through context-dependent metrics or constraints ( Stillwell et al., 2005 ) , graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) through context-dependent relational structure ( Courcelle, 1992 ) , category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) through indexed or fibered constructions ( Tarlecki et al., 1991 ) , and optimization ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) through context-dependent objectives or constraints ( Vandenberghe and Boyd, 2004 ) . In each case, however, contextual dependence is introduced through an additional construction rather than being a primitive organizing principle of the framework. Logic does not naturally provide context-sensitive conceptual meaning without extending the formalism with an explicit representation of context. Logic ( × \bm{\times} ) and algebra ( × \bm{\times} ) do not inherently represent contextual dependence.
blocks.zh: 环境化涉及随着周围环境的变化,概念的含义或适用性的系统变化(Barsalou,1982年)。 概率( )通过条件分布和马尔科夫决定过程等条件概率(Jaynes and Bretthorst, 2003),自然支持环境依赖性. 动态系统( )提供国家依赖行为的直接表现,其中当前状态改变了系统随后的演化(Storgatz, 2024). 游戏理论(\\bm\circ})代表着一个代理商的可用动作和报酬如何取决于其他代理商创造的战略背景,尽管背景化的意义不是其主要对象(Osborne and Rubinstein, 1994). 信息理论(\\bm\circ})可以直接通过有条件的 en,有条件的相互信息,以及相关的有条件措施(Cover et al.,1991)来表示环境依赖性. 其他框架通过额外的结构构造支持环境依赖性:几何学(\\bm\circ})通过环境依赖度量或制约因素(Stillwell等人,2005年),图表(\\bm\circ})通过环境依赖度关系结构(Courcelle,1992年),类别理论(\\bm\circ})通过指数化或纤维化构造(Tarlecki等人,1991年),以及优化(\\bm\circ})通过环境依赖度目标或制约因素(Vandenberghe和Boyd,2004年)。 然而,在每一种情况下,背景依赖都是通过附加构思引入的,而不是框架的原始组织原则. 逻辑学自然不会提供对上下文敏感的概念含义,而不以明确表达上下文的方式扩展形式主义. 逻辑(\\bm\times})和代数(\bm\times})在本质上并不代表背景依赖.

blocks.en: Discrimination concerns distinguishing between concepts that are close or easily confusable ( Green et al., 1966 ) . Geometry ( ✓ ) naturally supports discrimination through distances, boundaries, and separations in a metric or geometric space ( Stillwell et al., 2005 ) . Logic ( ✓ )provides canonical distinctions through predicates, truth conditions, and entailment ( Enderton, 2001 ) . Information theory ( ✓ ) provides measures of statistical distinguishability using measures such as Kullback-Leibler and Jensen-Shannon divergence ( Kullback and Leibler, 1951 ; Lin, 1991 ) . Probability ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) supports discrimination through posterior probabilities and likelihood ratios, which quantify relative support for competing hypotheses ( Berger, 1987 ; Casella and Berger, 2024 ) . Graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ), algebra ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ), category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ), and dynamical systems ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can distinguish entities through structural properties, such as graph connectivity, algebraic relations, categorical morphisms and isomorphisms, or differences in dynamical states and trajectories, but they do not intrinsically provide a criterion for deciding which distinctions are relevant for discrimination ( West and others, 2001 ; JS, 2022 ; Mac Lane and MacLane, 1971 ; Strogatz, 2024 ) . Optimization ( × \bm{\times} ) and game theory ( × \bm{\times} ) do not intrinsically provide mechanisms for discrimination; optimization selects solutions according to a specified objective, while game theory characterizes strategic interactions according to specified preferences, actions, and payoffs.
blocks.zh: 歧视涉及区分接近或容易混淆的概念(Green等人,1966年)。 几何学( )自然支持通过距离、边界和在度量或几何空间的分离进行区分(Stillwell等人,2005年)。 逻辑( ) 通过上游、 真相条件 和必然结果 提供教条区分( Enderton, 2001) 。 信息理论(✓)利用Kullback-Leibler和Jensen-Shannon Difference(Kullback和Leibler,1951年;Lin,1991年)等计量方法,提供了统计可辨别性的尺度。 概率(\\bm\circ})通过后概率和概率比率支持歧视,后者量化了对竞争假设的相对支持(Berger,1987年;Casella和Berger,2024年)。 图表(\\bm\circ}),代数(\\bm\circ}),类理论(\\bm\circ}),动态系统(\\\bm\circ}),和动态系统(\\\bm\circ})可以通过结构属性区分实体,例如图连通性,代数关系,断然的形态和异态,或者动态状态和轨迹的差异,但它们在本质上并没有为决定哪些区别与歧视有关提供一个标准(West等人,2001年;JS,2022年;Mac Lane和MacLane,1971年;Storgentz,2024年). 优化(\bm\times})和游戏理论(\bm\times})在本质上并没有为歧视提供机制;优化根据指定目标选择解决方案,而游戏理论则根据特定偏好,动作,以及回报来定性战略互动.

blocks.en: Generalization concerns extending a concept acquired from limited observations to novel instances ( Shepard, 1987 ; Mitchell, 1982 ) . Probability ( ✓ ) provides canonical machinery for generalization through statistical inference and prediction to unobserved or future cases ( Casella and Berger, 2024 ) , while optimization ( ✓ ) provides the objective-based machinery underlying many formal treatments of learning, including the minimization of empirical risk used to study generalization ( Vapnik and Izmailov, 2019 ) . Geometry ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support generalization through metric neighborhoods, spatial smoothness, interpolation, and geometric decision regions, but these mechanisms do not by themselves specify how experience determines behavior on unseen instances ( Devroye et al., 1996 ) . Information theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) provides tools for characterizing the relationship between learned representations and generalization, but does not itself define a generalization procedure ( Cover et al., 1991 ) . Logic ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support generalization by inducing rules from examples; graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) by learning reusable relational or local structural patterns; algebra ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) through reusable algebraic laws and invariants; category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) through structure-preserving mappings; and dynamical systems ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) by learning dynamical laws that predict unobserved states or trajectories. In each case, however, an additional learning or inference mechanism is required to determine which structures transfer to unseen instances ( Hamilton et al., 2017 ; Yu and Wang, 2024 ; Muggleton, 1991 ; Cohn, 2003 ; Mac Lane and MacLane, 1971 ) . Game theory ( × \bm{\times} ) does not support generalization from one solution to another.
blocks.zh: 一般化涉及将从有限观察获得的概念扩大到新情况(Shepard,1987年;Mitchell,1982年)。 概率( )通过统计推论和预测未观察或未来案例(Casella和Berger, 2024年),为泛化提供了犬类机械(✓),而优化(✓)则提供了许多正式的学习处理所基于的客观机制,包括尽量减少用于研究泛化的经验风险(Vapnik和Izmailov, 2019年). 几何学(\\bm\circ})可以通过测量邻里,空间平滑,内插,和几何决定区域来支持概括化,但这些机制本身并没有具体说明经验如何决定在不见的情况下的行为(Devroye等人,1996年). 信息理论(\\bm\circ})为描述所学的表达和概括之间的关系提供了工具,但本身并不定义概括程序(Cover等人,1991年). 逻辑学 (\\bm\circ})可以通过从示例中诱导规则来支持概括化; 图表学 (\\bm\circ}) 通过学习可重复使用的关系模式或局部结构模式; 代数学 (\\bm\circ}) 通过可重复使用的代数定律和不变量; 类别理论 (\\\bm\circ}) 通过结构保留绘图; 动态系统 (\\bm\circ}) 通过学习动态定律来预测不可观察状态或轨迹. 然而,在每一种情况下,都需要一个额外的学习或推论机制,以确定哪些结构转移到隐形情况下(Hamilton等人,2017年;Yu和Wang,2024年;Muggleton,1991年;Cohn,2003年;Mac Lane和MacLane,1971年)。 游戏理论(\\bm\times})不支持从一个解决方案到另一个解决方案的泛化.

blocks.en: Grounding concerns connecting conceptual representations to something external to the conceptual system, such as sensory observations, actions, or the physical environment ( Harnad, 1990 ) . Probability ( ✓ ) naturally supports grounding by linking latent variables or hypotheses to observable evidence through generative and observation models ( Pearl, 2014 ) . Graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support grounding by representing relations between abstract concepts and entities or observations in the world, as in knowledge graphs and scene graphs, but grounding requires an additional mapping between graph representations and external or perceptual entities ( Hofer et al., 2024 ) . Information theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can characterize the statistical relationship between conceptual representations and their external referents through measures such as mutual information, but statistical dependence alone does not establish a grounding or reference relation ( Usher, 2001 ) . Category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can represent mappings between conceptual and external domains through morphisms and functors, although the identification and interpretation of those domains must be supplied separately ( Awodey, 2006 ; Mac Lane and MacLane, 1971 ) . Dynamical systems ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can model coupling between internal states and environmental variables through coupled dynamical equations, although such coupling does not by itself establish a grounding relation ( Beer, 2000 ) . Optimization ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can connect internal representations to actions and environmental outcomes by optimizing task objectives defined over their consequences ( Sutton et al., 1998 ) . Algebra ( × \bm{\times} ), logic ( × \bm{\times} ), geometry ( × \bm{\times} ), and game theory ( × \bm{\times} ) do not intrinsically provide an external grounding relation. Game theory ( × \bm{\times} ) can represent interactions with environments or other agents, but interaction alone does not establish semantic grounding.
blocks.zh: 将概念表述与概念系统之外的东西联系起来,例如感官观察、行动或物理环境(Harnad,1990年)。 概率( )通过基因和观测模型将潜在变量或假说与可观测证据联系起来,自然支持打地(珍珠,2014年)。 图形(\\bm\circ})可以通过代表抽象概念与世界实体或观测之间的关系来支持地基,如在知识图和场景图中,但地基需要图示与外部或感知实体之间额外的绘图(Hofer等人,2024年). 信息理论(\\bm\circ})可以通过相互信息等措施来描述概念表述与其外部参考物之间的统计关系,但仅靠统计依赖并不能建立基础关系或参考关系(Usher,2001). 分类理论(\\bm\circ})可以通过形态学和真菌学来代表概念域和外部域之间的映射,尽管对这些域的识别和解释必须分别提供(Awody,2006;Mac Lane和MacLane,1971). 动态系统(\\bm\circ})可以通过组合的动态方程来模拟内部状态和环境变量之间的耦合,尽管这种耦合本身并不能建立地基关系(Beer, 2000). 优化(\\bm\circ})可以通过优化针对其后果确定的任务目标,将内部表述与行动和环境结果联系起来(Sutton等人,1998年)。 代数 (\bm\times}),逻辑 (\bm\times}),几何学 (\bm\times}),和游戏理论 (\\bm\times})在本质上不能提供外部地基关系. 游戏理论(\\bm\times})可以代表与环境或其他代理人的相互作用,但单是相互作用并不能建立语义定位.

blocks.en: Inference concerns deriving new beliefs or conclusions from existing conceptual knowledge ( Osherson et al., 1990 ) . Logic ( ✓ ) provides canonical machinery for inference through formal deduction and logical entailment ( Enderton, 2001 ) . Probability ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) supports probabilistic inference through conditional probability, Bayesian inference, and probabilistic graphical models, but inference depends on a specified probabilistic model and inferential procedure ( Pearl, 2014 ) . Graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) support inference when relational structure encodes dependencies or constraints, allowing information to propagate through paths and connected variables ( Koller and Friedman, 2009 ) . Algebra ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) supports reasoning through algebraic laws, identities, and structure-preserving transformations, while category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) supports compositional reasoning through morphism composition, commutative diagrams, and universal properties ( JS, 2022 ; Awodey, 2006 ) . Game theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) supports inference about strategic behavior through equilibrium and related solution concepts ( Fudenberg and Tirole, 1991 ) . Geometry ( × \bm{\times} ) and dynamical systems ( × \bm{\times} ) can support inference about spatial or temporal systems, but it is a different type of inference from the intended one, and optimization ( × \bm{\times} ) primarily specifies the selection of solutions under an objective and therefore does not, by itself, constitute conceptual inference.
blocks.zh: 从现有概念知识中得出新信念或结论的推论问题(Osherson等人,1990年)。 逻辑( )通过正式的推论和逻辑推论提供可推论的犬学机械(Enderton,2001年)。 概率(\\bm\circ})通过条件概率,贝叶斯推论,和概率图形模型支持概率推论,但推论取决于指定的概率模型和推论程序(Pearl, 2014). 图形 (\\bm\circ}) 当关系结构编码依赖性或制约时支持推论,允许信息通过路径和连接变量传播(Koller and Friedman, 2009). 代数(\\bm\circ})通过代数定律,身份和结构保留转换支持推理,而类别理论(\\bm\circ})通过形态学组成,共性图,和普世属性支持组成推理(JS, 2022; Awody, 2006). 游戏理论 (\\bm\circ})支持通过平衡和相关解决方案概念对战略行为的推论(Fudenberg and Tirole, 1991). 几何(\bm\times})和动态系统(\bm\times})可以支持对空间或时间系统的推论,但它是与预期的推论不同的类型,优化(\bm\times})主要规定在一个目标下选择解决方案,因此本身并不构成概念推论.

blocks.en: Learning concerns the acquisition of concepts from experience or data ( Bruner, 2017 ; Valiant, 1984 ) . Probability ( ✓ ) provides a canonical framework for learning through statistical inference and posterior updates ( Ghahramani, 2015 ) , and optimization ( ✓ ) provides the central machinery for parameter estimation and empirical risk minimization ( Vapnik, 1998 ) . Information theory ( ✓ ) naturally characterizes learning in terms of information acquisition and better compression ( Shannon, 1948 ) . Geometry ( ✓ ) can support learning through geometric models of representations and decision boundaries ( Bronstein et al., 2017 ) . Dynamical systems ( ✓ ) naturally represent learning when it is formulated as a trajectory through parameter or state space ( Chen et al., 2018 ) . Graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) and category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support learning through graph-structured or relational representations, but learning requires additional algorithms or objectives ( Battaglia et al., 2018 ; Coecke et al., 2010 ) . Logic ( × \bm{\times} ) and algebra ( × \bm{\times} ) do not naturally provide mechanisms for acquiring concepts from data.
blocks.zh: 学习涉及从经验或数据中获得概念(Bruner,2017;Valiant,1984.). 概率( )为通过统计推论和事后更新(Ghahramani, 2015年)进行学习提供了标准框架,优化(✓)为参数估计和经验风险最小化提供了核心机制(Vapnik, 1998年)。 信息理论( )在信息获取和更好的压缩方面自然具有学习的特点(Shannon,1948年)。 几何学( )可以支持通过几何模型的表达和决定边界进行学习(Bronstein等人,2017年). 动态系统( )在通过参数或状态空间形成轨道时,自然代表学习(Chen等人,2018年)。 Graphs (\\bm\circ})和类别理论 (\\bm\circ})可以通过图结构或关系表示支持学习,但学习需要额外的算法或目标(Battaglia等人,2018年;Coecke等人,2010年). 逻辑学 (\\bm\times})和代数学 (\bm\times}) 自然不能提供从数据获取概念的机制.

blocks.en: Revision concerns updating or overturning an existing concept in response to new evidence ( Carey, 1985 ; Chi, 1992 ) . Probability ( ✓ ) provides the most direct canonical mechanism through Bayesian updating, in which beliefs are systematically revised in light of observations ( Jaynes, 1996 ) . Dynamical systems ( ✓ ) naturally represent revision as state evolution, although the interpretation of the changing state as a revised concept must be supplied ( Shannon, 1948 ) . Optimization ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can support revision through iterative parameter updates, but this depends on an externally specified objective ( Sutton et al., 1998 ) . Graphs ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ), algebra ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ), and category theory ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can represent the result of a revision, e.g., an edge or node update in a graph, an algebraic rewriting rule, a new morphism in a category ( Ehrig et al., 2006 ; Rozenberg, 1997 ; Baader and Nipkow, 1998 ; Lack and Sobociński, 2005 ) . However, none specifies when incoming evidence should trigger such a change or which of several possible transformations counts as the correct revision, without an externally supplied revision rule. Geometry ( ∘ \bm{\circ} ) can represent movement or deformation of representations, but does not itself provide a mechanism for deciding when an existing concept should be revised ( Gärdenfors, 2000 ) . Logic ( × \bm{\times} ) can represent nonmonotonic or belief-revision systems, but classical logic alone does not naturally support revision in response to contradictory evidence.
blocks.zh: 修订涉及根据新证据更新或推翻现有概念(Carey,1985年;Chi,1992年). 概率(✓)通过巴耶斯语更新提供了最直接的教条机制,其中根据观察系统地修订信仰(Jaynes,1996年)。 动态系统( )自然代表了作为国家演变的修订,尽管必须提供将不断变化的状态解释为一个订正概念(Shannon,1948年)。 优化(\\bm\circ})可以通过迭代参数更新支持修订,但这取决于外部指定的目标(Sutton等人,1998年). 图形(\\bm\circ}),代数(\\bm\circ}),和类理论(\\bm\circ})可以代表修订的结果,如图中的边缘或节点更新,代数重写规则,一类中的新形态(Ehrig等人,2006年;Rozenberg,1997年; Baader and Nipkow,1998年;Lack and Sobocinski,2005年)。 但是,没有一项具体规定,在没有外部提供的订正规则的情况下,何时收到的证据应引起这种改变,或者哪些可能的改变是正确的订正。 几何学(\\bm\circ})可以代表表示的移动或变形,但本身并不提供一种机制来决定何时应该修改一个现有概念(Gärdenfors, 2000.). 逻辑学 (\\bm\times})可以代表非morotonic或信仰修正系统,但光是古典逻辑并不能自然支持针对矛盾的证据进行修正.

blocks.en: Together, these assessments define the operational comparison in Table 2 . The assignments should not be interpreted as claims about the expressive limits of any framework. Rather, they identify which conceptual operations each mathematical perspective makes most natural. This distinction is important: a framework may be capable of representing an operation without making that operation mathematically primitive. The resulting complementarity suggests that a general mathematics of concepts may be better understood as an integration of mathematical perspectives, each providing different portions of the conceptual interface, than as the search for a single universally sufficient formalism.
blocks.zh: 这些评估一起确定了表2的业务比较。 转让不应被解释为对任何框架明示限制的要求。 相反,它们确定了每个数学视角最自然的概念操作。 这种区分很重要:一个框架可能能够代表一个操作而不使该操作在数学上是原始的. 由此产生的互补性表明,概念的一般数学可以被更好地理解为对数学视角的整合,每个视角提供概念界面的不同部分,而不是寻找一个单一的普遍充分的形式主义.

blocks.en: Appendix B Mathematical Frameworks
blocks.zh: 附录B 数学 框架

blocks.en: Table 4 provides a concise overview of the ten mathematical frameworks considered in our analysis, summarizing their core assumptions, mathematical objects, canonical constructions, and guiding philosophies. We treat these frameworks as distinct mathematical languages for describing conceptual structure: each makes certain properties and operations explicit while leaving others implicit or requiring additional assumptions. The frameworks therefore differ not in whether they can ultimately implement a given conceptual operation, but in how naturally that operation is expressed within their native mathematical structure.
blocks.zh: 表4简要概括了我们分析中考虑的十个数学框架,概括了它们的核心假设,数学对象,教条构造,指导哲学. 我们把这些框架当作不同的数学语言来描述概念结构:每个框架都使某些属性和操作明确,而其他框架则隐含或需要额外的假设. 因此,这些框架在它们能否最终实施一个特定的概念操作方面并不不同,而是在其本土数学结构内如何自然地表达这一操作.

blocks.en: Table 4: Conceptual overview of the ten mathematical frameworks considered in our comparison. For each framework, we summarize its core assumption, basic mathematical objects, canonical constructions, and guiding philosophy. These descriptions provide the interpretive assumptions underlying the operational comparison in Table 2 ; they are intentionally high-level and do not exhaust the mathematical variants or applications of any framework.
blocks.zh: 表4:我们比较中考虑的十个数学框架的概念概述。 对于每个框架,我们总结它的核心假设,基本数学对象,教条构造,以及指导哲学. 这些描述提供了表2中业务比较所依据的解释性假设;这些假设是故意高层次的,没有用尽任何框架的数学变体或应用。

blocks.en: Table 5 depicts the results of the empirical investigation of the categorization operation of concepts.
blocks.zh: 表5说明了对概念分类操作的经验调查的结果。

blocks.en: Three of the nine are supervised and use category labels during fitting, so their predictive scores are not directly comparable to the six unsupervised methods. The methods also require different auxiliary resources and therefore cover different subsets of the items: the knowledge graph covers nearly all items, whereas property norms cover 60-76%. Finally, predictive accuracy is defined only for the supervised methods; for the others, we report cluster accuracy after optimal matching, which measures agreement with the human partition under a different criterion. We therefore do not interpret Table 5 as a ranking.
blocks.zh: 9人中有3人被监督,在安装时使用类别标签,因此他们的预测分数不能直接与6个无监督方法相比. 这些方法还需要不同的辅助资源,因此涵盖项目的不同子集:知识图涵盖几乎所有项目,而财产规范涵盖60-76%。 最后,预测准确性的定义只针对被监督的方法;对其他方法,我们报告在最佳匹配之后的集群准确性,该组合在不同的标准下衡量与人类分区的一致. 因此,我们不把表5解释为排名。

blocks.en: These scores indicate how well each operationalization recovers the human category structure under its particular mathematical commitments and input representation. Thus, a low score is evidence that the corresponding operationalization provides a poor account of human categorization in this setting, although it does not by itself identify whether the limitation lies in the mathematical framework, its representation, its auxiliary data, or its implementation. Conversely, higher recovery provides evidence that the framework captures aspects of categorization reflected in the human judgments.
blocks.zh: 这些分数表明,在具体数学承诺和投入表述下,每次操作如何恢复人类类别结构。 因此,较低的分数表明,相应的可操作性在此情况下对人类分类的描述不佳,尽管它本身并不能确定限制在于数学框架、其表述、其辅助数据还是其实施。 相反,较高的回收率提供证据表明,该框架涵盖了人类判决中所反映的分类方面。

blocks.en: The two highest-performing methods are supervised, consistent with the advantage of access to category labels during fitting. Among the non-supervised methods, the strongest performers are those classified as ✓ in Table 2 , suggesting that frameworks that naturally support categorization also tend to provide stronger accounts of human category structure when instantiated on this task.
blocks.zh: 两种最高性能的方法都受到监督,这符合在安装期间访问类别标签的好处。 在不受监督的方法中,表现最强的是表2中被列为“______________________________”的方法,这表明自然支持分类的框架在对这项任务进行即决时,也倾向于更有力地说明人类类别的结构。

blocks.en: The disagreement also reveals distinct sources of error. The four embedding-based accounts place crowbar among birds. Under mean pooling, cos ⁡ ( ​ c ​ r ​ o ​ w ​ b ​ a ​ r , ​ c ​ r ​ o ​ w ) = 0.735 \cos(\emph{crowbar},\emph{crow})=0.735 , and nine of its ten nearest neighbors are birds, while its similarity to other tools does not exceed 0.32 0.32 . The compound therefore inherits the neighborhood of its leading subword. A similar effect appears in pairs such as blackberry - blackjack , which have cosine similarity 0.719 0.719 . In contrast, the property-norm accounts place crowbar among weapons, while the knowledge-graph account assigns it no coherent neighborhood.

blocks.en: This example illustrates why agreement across implementations should not automatically be interpreted as independent evidence. The four embedding-based accounts share the same input representation and therefore can inherit the same representational bias. Conversely, disagreement between methods based on different representations can help identify which source of information drives an error. Thus, the qualitative analysis complements the aggregate scores by revealing the representational assumptions underlying both convergence and divergence across mathematical accounts.
blocks.zh: 这个例子说明为什么不应自动将整个执行中的一致意见解释为独立证据。 四个嵌入式账户共用相同的输入表示,因此可以继承相同的代表偏差. 相反,基于不同表述的方法之间的分歧有助于确定哪一个信息来源导致错误。 因此,定性分析通过揭示数学账户趋同和差异背后的表述假设来补充总分。
